data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node shares mechanism with SRC_002's auxiliary-chain construction: each diagnostic witness (defense witness, residue, fragility) is encoded as a bounded-depth auxiliary node that attacks all attackers of the warrant, so the diagnostic post-pass family is a Dung-native part of the attack graph rather than an external scoring layer. Refuted if a diagnostic witness can be produced that does not correspond to any bounded auxiliary chain with fixed k.
